title: Arithmetic criterion for Jordan Siegel disks
exact_target: Find an arithmetic criterion for a quadratic Siegel disk to have a Jordan boundary, including whether a Diophantine-exponent threshold separates sufficient from insufficient bounds.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300022 (AMR-052-0022). CC BY 4.0.
Lennart Carleson, Geometry of Julia sets, in Ben Bielefeld and Mikhail Lyubich (editors), Problems in holomorphic dynamics (1992). Siegel-disk arithmetic paragraph, p. 19.
